description: This file provides utility functions for writing and flushing data to files or stdout, including error handling for I/O operations such as flush, write, fsync, and fwrite.

methods.name: void maybe_flush_or_die(FILE * f,const char * desc)
methods.description: Flushes the FILE stream if needed, with error handling.

methods.name: void fprintf_or_die(FILE * f,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and writes data to a FILE stream, terminating on error.

methods.name: int maybe_fsync(int fd)
methods.description: Performs an fsync on a file descriptor if environment and conditions permit.

methods.name: void fsync_or_die(int fd,const char * msg)
methods.description: Performs an fsync operation and exits with error message if it fails.

methods.name: int fsync_component(enum fsync_component component,int fd)
methods.description: Performs fsync for a specific component if enabled.

methods.name: void fsync_component_or_die(enum fsync_component component,int fd,const char * msg)
methods.description: Performs fsync for a specific component, terminating on failure.

methods.name: void write_or_die(int fd,const void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, exits on error.

methods.name: void fwrite_or_die(FILE * f,const void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Writes data to a FILE stream, terminates on failure.

methods.name: void fflush_or_die(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes a FILE stream, with error handling.

ctags.name: fsync_component_or_die
ctags.pattern: /^void fsync_component_or_die(enum fsync_component component, int fd, const char *msg)$/

ctags.name: write_or_die
ctags.pattern: /^void write_or_die(int fd, const void *buf, size_t count)$/
